text:
liz: heads-up — seeing p99 token latency spike on the token-level SLO dashboard for us-west1, started ~22:10 UTC. Grafana panel: https://grafana.internal/d/token-slo/token-slo?orgId=1&var-region=us-west1

liz: p50/p95 look fine, p99 jumped from ~180ms -> ~1.2s. tokens/sec stable, so throughput unchanged. cost per-token hasn't moved yet.

amar: checking k8s events now, I see a burst of node/pod restarts in cluster-gpu-west1 around the same time. snippet: `kubectl get events --namespace infra --field-selector type=Warning` shows ENI attach errors and pod evictions

nish: also seeing network interface errors on multiple GPU hosts. Prom query: `sum by(instance) (rate(node_network_receive_errs_total[5m]))` had spikes coincident with the p99 jump

mika: ruling out kvcache hot-path — cache hit ratio steady at ~98% (prom: `redwood_kvcache_hit_ratio`), so likely infra-level networking rather than model hotshard problems

liz: pasted relevant agent logs: `/var/log/gpu-agent/gpu_agent.log` -> repeated `failed to attach ENI: timeout` and `dhcp lease timeout` around 22:09:45

sre_oncall: infra-bot fired earlier: `ALERT: NetworkInterfaceAttachFailures (severity=warning)` at 1759876490. looks like ENI attach latency + quota errors in subnet-a-us-west1

amar: confirmed — subnet in us-west1 is close to ENI limits after the recent rollout. ENI attach requests are queuing in the cloud provider, causing attach delays -> pod network flaps leading to p99 token latency spikes

nish: temporary mitigation: patched kube-controller to prefer ENI reuse and reduce churn; also requested bump to ENI quota in AWS console. rolling the controller patch now (canary at 2 nodes)

mika: suggestion for dashboards/alerts: add a Grafana panel correlating token p99 with `node_network_receive_errs_total` and `kube_pod_container_status_restarts_total`. propose alert: `WHEN p99_tokens > 500ms AND increase(pod_restarts[5m]) > 0`

liz: yes — also add automatic annotation when ENI attach alerts fire so the tokens SLO graph shows the alert timeline for quicker triage

sre_oncall: post-patch observation: p99 dropped back down to ~220ms within ~6 minutes. Leaving monitoring on and opening a follow-up ticket for capacity/quotas: ENGINFRA-3421

infra-bot: Created ticket ENGINFRA-3421 — Increase ENI pool and add quota dashboards for regional subnets (https://tickets.internal/ENGINFRA-3421)

amar: cost heads-up — if we permanently enlarge ENI pools we may need a few pre-warmed filler nodes; rough estimate ~$1.2k/month for the us-west1 guard capacity. adding cost estimate to ENGINFRA-3421

nish: I'll add a Prom rule to compute `eni_headroom = region_max_enis - region_used_enis` and alert when headroom < 3 for 10m. will include per-instance-type breakdown

mika: will push the Grafana panel + alert rule to staging and link in the ticket. will also annotate the dashboard with the ENI alert history

liz: thanks all — keeping an eye on the region for the next 2h. summarizing: root cause = ENI quota/headroom + attach latency causing pod networking flaps -> transient p99 token latency spike. follow-ups in ENGINFRA-3421
